results.question: 按区域和渠道查看2026年6月收入、订单和毛利。
results.sqlbot_generated_sql: SELECT "r"."region_name" AS "region_name", "c"."channel_name" AS "channel_name", COALESCE(SUM("o"."net_revenue"), 0) AS "total_revenue", COUNT(DISTINCT "o"."order_id") AS "order_count", COALESCE(SUM("o"."gross_profit"), 0) AS "total_gross_profit" FROM "sales_order" AS "o" JOIN "sales_region" AS "r" ON "o"."region_id" = "r"."region_id" JOIN "sales_channel" AS "c" ON "o"."channel_id" = "c"."channel_id" WHERE "o"."order_date" >= CAST('2026-06-01' AS DATE) AND "o"."order_date" < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY "r"."region_name", "c"."channel_name" ORDER BY "r"."region_name", "c"."channel_name" LIMIT 500

results.question: 按客户分群和区域查看收入与客单价。
results.sqlbot_generated_sql: SELECT "c"."customer_segment" AS "customer_segment", "r"."region_name" AS "region_name", SUM("o"."net_revenue") AS "sales_revenue", ROUND(SUM("o"."net_revenue") / COUNT(DISTINCT "o"."order_id"), 2) AS "average_order_value" FROM "sales_order" AS "o" JOIN "sales_customer" AS "c" ON "o"."customer_id" = "c"."customer_id" JOIN "sales_region" AS "r" ON "o"."region_id" = "r"."region_id" GROUP BY "c"."customer_segment", "r"."region_name" ORDER BY "c"."customer_segment", "r"."region_name" LIMIT 500

results.question: 按销售人员、区域和组织查看订单与毛利率。
results.sqlbot_generated_sql: SELECT "so"."salesperson_id" AS "salesperson_id", "sr"."region_id" AS "region_id", "sr"."organization_code" AS "organization_code", COUNT(DISTINCT "so"."order_id") AS "order_count", COALESCE(SUM("so"."net_revenue"), 0) AS "sales_revenue", COALESCE(SUM("so"."gross_profit"), 0) AS "gross_profit", CASE WHEN SUM("so"."net_revenue") = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM("so"."gross_profit") / SUM("so"."net_revenue") * 100, 2) END AS "gross_margin_percent" FROM "sales_order" AS "so" INNER JOIN "sales_region" AS "sr" ON "so"."region_id" = "sr"."region_id" INNER JOIN "salesperson" AS "sp" ON "so"."salesperson_id" = "sp"."salesperson_id" GROUP BY "so"."salesperson_id", "sr"."region_id", "sr"."organization_code" ORDER BY "sr"."organization_code", "sr"."region_id", "so"."salesperson_id" LIMIT 500
